indexed_filter_followup_metadata.followup_scope: Eight prospectively frozen follow-up runs motivated by observed explicit inventory materialization. Exact original filtered universes and admission costs reused. Same original paired cohort, not new held-out/cold trials. Original 32 jobs and all UNKNOWN results retained.

limitations: Arithmetic is an addition-zero/equality-congruence fragment, without induction or full PA; incidence is purely symbolic and one-sorted, without coordinates, segment-congruence axioms or full Hilbert geometry. No newly trained RL, ATP advantage or unrestricted FOL completeness is established.

Family proofs use an anchored symbolic point-tree carrier. The separate Wang lane offers all100 fixed-orientation square types at every finite circuit cell; its program selectors are problem pins on interior vertical edges too. It has not searched arithmetic or geometry proofs on one universal fixed Wang palette.

Only actual native solver/control outputs are checked. Repeated symbol renamings, bounds and method outputs are not distinct new mathematical theorem discoveries. MARKS may return a padded proof while DP optimizes expanded tree-node count.

UNSAT/NOT_DERIVABLE concern the complete declared finite native basis and height. UNKNOWN is never a logical negative. The incidence jobs do not establish that the unrestricted geometric implication is unprovable.

Exact all-rooted-proof-set enumeration was not attempted for richer profiles. Preserved-rooted-proof claims use the checked bounded absence-certificate argument and exact transformed inventory, not a sampled or truncated set comparison.

Explicit FILTER embeds its full restricted inventory in the model and repeated audit snapshots; MARKS uses indexed packets. That representation and evidence cost confounds their raw timing comparison. IFILTER is a separately declared follow-up using the same static filtered inventory through an indexed provider; original jobs were not rerun or replaced.

Common preparation was measured once per case and reused. Per-method end-to-end figures are clearly labeled accounting projections of observed stages, not independently timed cold trials. DP is not charged point-universe, marking-acquisition or model-materialization work. Full once-only preparation and process totals remain separately recorded.

The original Wang driver exited1 because it asserted on a retained resource UNKNOWN. First three original jobs, including the partial32-cell parity attempt, remain immutable; only the never-run fourth job was executed in recovery at the same caps. No full tiling is synthesized for the UNKNOWN case.

Audit journal/storage/work limits can stop a job after an event was emitted but before its snapshot was retained. Complete stored event-record hashes do not turn that missing observation into verified graph coverage. Refused assurance stays UNKNOWN.

This assembler only joins saved bytes, scope digests, extents and receipts. It reruns no scientific computation and does not independently prove the correctness of the kernel, search implementation or catalogue checker.

The first saved-data assembler stopped on a raw-versus-normalized Wang universe hash comparison. Version2 only applies the declared support/CID/model ordering normalization when joining checker content hashes; original Source, raw pins and the failed audit attempt remain retained. No scientific job was replayed.
